roofer.tool: Roofer 1.0.0 (bb2a85a), 3DBAG / TU Delft 3D geoinformation, GPL-3.0; used offline, not bundled
roofer.command: roofer -j 16 --bld-class 1 --grnd-class 2 --id-attribute bid --h-terrain-attribute h_terrain --h-terrain-strategy buffer_user --no-lod22 --lod13 --cj-translate 0 0 0 --srs EPSG:32610 points.laz footprints.geojson out
roofer.srs_note: EPSG:32610 is passed only as a metric label; the points and footprints are already in the game frame (x east, y = -Z north)
roofer.pass2_command: roofer -j 16 --bld-class 1 --grnd-class 2 --id-attribute bid --h-terrain-attribute h_terrain --h-terrain-strategy buffer_user --no-lod22 --lod13 --cj-translate 0 0 0 --srs EPSG:32610 --filter "bid IN ('201006.0005176','201006.0020775','201006.0023927','osm:way/32864957','osm:way/332516647')" points.laz footprints_pass2.geojson out-pass2

heights: Metres above the city's surveyed median ground (2010 footprints) or the median 2010 ground nearby (additions). City 2010 heights stay authoritative for 2010 footprints; LiDAR parts only add what rises above them.

additions.name: Serif
additions.reason: replaces 2010 footprints whose 2023 LiDAR height no longer matches

additions.name: Prism
additions.reason: replaces 2010 footprints whose 2023 LiDAR height no longer matches
